statistics.warmup: excluded from statistics, retained in raw reports
statistics.selection: latest passed index row per case key; running/failed cases excluded

metric_definitions.cache_maintenance: writer_flush + reader_invalidate, each local duration includes its batch fence
metric_definitions.bookkeeping: source harvest + source rearm + source bitmap_scan + destination bitmap_scan + destination manifest_hash
metric_definitions.mechanism_local_stage_sum: cache_maintenance + bookkeeping; sum of nonoverlapping sequential local stages, not cross-node timestamp subtraction
metric_definitions.source.pause_to_ack: source-local KVM_RUN completion to destination-maintenance ACK observation, includes TCP control; excludes guest_run and full verification
metric_definitions.source.guest_run: KVM_RUN through HLT return; includes VM exits and PML buffer draining, excludes KVM_SET_REGS
metric_definitions.bitmap_scan: exact expected-bitmap comparison and set-bit list construction; receiver manifest hash is measured separately
metric_definitions.destination.verify: after ACK: every page's written prefix plus final untouched word for 64B writes; excludes next writer until VERIFIED

limits: Host native KVM uses shared memfd RAM, with no filesystem writeback; guest scope uses shared device-DAX inside two nested-KVM Linux VMs. Never pool their measurements.
Native and nested scopes also use different execution kernels (physical host 5.15 versus L1 6.6); their latency differences cannot isolate CXL backing or nesting alone.
Neither scope reproduces stale private caches on a physical noncoherent CXL fabric; cache instructions execute on a coherent physical host.
This is a flat 32-bit KVM guest stub without a guest OS, devices, interrupts, Firecracker, or detach/attach; values are component costs, not VM migration latency.
Memory sizes and full-range maintenance refer to the shared data memslot only; a separate 4MiB node-private code/command memslot is excluded.
Host dirty-logging on/off is a native PML-enabled KVM comparison; guest nested PML may be emulated. Neither delta is a measurement of pure hardware log instruction cost.

Primary cases warm both retained KVMs with serialized guest writes of all 4096 bytes of every page using the original seed, then harvest/reset dirty logs before timing; read-only-prefault and disk-backed-write-prefault pilots are excluded.

Actual dirty epoch pages are exact-validated against a rotating permutation, with no guest RAM copy. The pf_fixed diagnostic counts MMU events returned as RET_PF_FIXED, including successful fast repairs in the supplied kernel; it is neither all MMU faults nor a latency metric.
The vCPU-wide pf_fixed counter covers every memslot, including private guest code/commands; it cannot attribute a count specifically to the shared data slot.

A zero pf_fixed delta does not prove absence of MMU/EPT exit work: spurious, retry and other return paths or translation work are not exhaustively represented. Guest-scope counts also cannot observe L0 nested faults or PML emulation.
Some native samples have nonzero pf_fixed deltas; logging-on/off differences can include translation/refault and VM-exit work and must not be called pure hardware PML cost.
The fixed odd-stride address permutation is deterministic and can have spatial clusters at a given density; it is not a uniformly random locality workload.
Selective and full maintenance process all 64 cachelines per selected 4KiB page, for both 64B and 4096B writes. Address-range bytes are not measured CXL writeback traffic.
Full post-ACK verification warms all pages' written prefixes every epoch; it is outside ACK timing but affects cache state equally within matched configurations.
None mode disables measured cache operations but still uses initial clean-cache setup; it is a coherent baseline, not proof of noncoherent correctness.

The known workload oracle lets the source compute its expected-manifest hash before guest execution; receiver hash validation is included in bookkeeping. A generic unknown workload may need source hash construction after harvest.
At 0% dirty, selective maintenance still includes empty-batch fence and timing overhead; per-dirty-page normalization is undefined.
Cases run sequentially, n=20 measured balanced directions by default. Round matching does not remove scheduling/thermal/run-order noise; negative differences remain unmodified.
Do not add guest execution, verification, source observed ACK and mechanism stage sum together: observed ACK already contains the mechanism and TCP control.

record_format.description: One JSON object per original CACHE_BENCH_JSON record. The original record is unchanged inside record; case_key/scope annotate origin. warmup is true or false for source/destination epochs and null for start/complete lifecycle events. Each epoch has one source and one destination record.

optional_diagnostic.trace_includes: setup prefault and all six epochs
limits: nested PML is emulated by L0; tracing perturbs diagnostic timings
optional_diagnostic.note: PML-full counts can be zero because ordinary VM exits drain partially filled PML buffers; traces include setup and perturb timing.
